# HugeHard Studio

> “这图能改” (English site name: “This Pic Can Change”) is an iPhone photo and video utility for iOS 17 and later. Images can be converted among HEIC, JPEG, PNG, and GIF, cropped, rotated, resized, or compressed. Video clips can be turned into GIFs or Live Photos; video compression is also available. The app interface is Simplified Chinese, and iPad runs the iPhone compatibility layout. Version 1.2 (5) is open for public TestFlight testing and is not on the App Store.

The public TestFlight build 1.2 (5) includes six on-device media tools: video to Live Photo, video compression, video to GIF, image compression, format conversion, and resizing. It also includes Screenshot Delivery, photo widgets, four games, and optional AI image generation and editing configured by the user. Ordinary image and video processing runs on device. Optional AI requests go to the configured provider, which may process submitted content and charge the user. Join the public TestFlight beta: [install version 1.2 (5)](https://testflight.apple.com/join/GK8ht2vv). Install TestFlight on iPhone first. Support: hugehardzhang@gmail.com.
